page.overview:
What is Devil's Dance?

Devil's Dance is the 3rd song on Metallica's 7th studio album ReLoad. "Devil's Dance" is also on S&M.

I feel you too Feel those things you do In your eyes I see a fire that burns To free the you That's wanting to through Deep inside you know the seeds I plant will grow

One day you will see And dare to come down to me C'mon, c'mon now take the chance That's right, let's dance

Snake, I am the snake Tempting, that bite to take Let me make your mind Leave yourself behind Be not afraid I've got what you need Hunger I will feed
